title: Please Stop
can_do: 清楚地要求停止身体互动，并在对方立即停止后选择自己需要的空间。
trigger: Dad gives one light playful tickle. Child does not like it and asks him to stop; Dad ends contact immediately at the first stop.
setting: A brief playful moment while Dad and Child sit on a broad sofa at home.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Please stop. I don't like that.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Thank you. I need some space now.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Sure. I'll sit on the far cushion.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: This much space is just right.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: I'll stay here. You can tell me anytime.

replay_cards.title: Stop the loud sound
replay_cards.setting: Silly music play at home with Dad
replay_cards.change: A playful sound near Child becomes uncomfortable
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks Dad to stop and Dad ends the sound immediately. Once it is quiet, Dad asks whether Child wants a softer game. Child clarifies, "No, I need some quiet." Dad accepts. If Child says "I'm not ready yet," Dad gives him quiet time; no new game starts until Child chooses it.

replay_cards.title: Do not move my hair
replay_cards.setting: Getting ready by a mirror with Mom
replay_cards.change: Mom lightly rearranges Child's hair, and Child decides he wants to do it himself
replay_cards.challenge: Child says "Please stop. I don't like that." Mom immediately takes her hands away and rests them down before discussing what happens next. Child asks to brush his own hair; Mom passes the brush and waits beside him without touching his hair again. The first boundary is enough, even without please or an explanation.

parent_support: Stop contact immediately at the first clear stop, put both hands down and only then discuss space or another interaction. Do not require please, eye contact, laughter to end, or an explanation.
Use firm normal-volume speech for the boundary. Follow the choice of space immediately; a high five is only an offered option and never a required gesture of reconciliation.
